subject: ATR 42/72 系統綜合 - 頂部面板 (Overhead Panel)

mc_questions.zh_question: 關於起落架次要指示燈 (Secondary Indicator) 的邏輯，下列敘述何者正確？
zh_options: (A) 綠色三角形代表起落架已收起且上鎖 (Up and Locked)
(B) 紅色 UNLK 燈亮起代表起落架正在作動中且未鎖定 (In transit and not locked)
(C) 指示燈完全不亮代表起落架已放下且鎖定 (Down and Locked)
(D) 琥珀色燈代表起落架門未關閉
mc_questions.en_question: Regarding the Landing Gear secondary indicator logic, which of the following statements is correct?
en_options: (A) Green triangle means the gear is up and locked
(B) Red UNLK light means the gear is in transit and not locked
(C) No lights at all means the gear is down and locked
(D) Amber light indicates the gear doors are not closed
mc_questions.explanation: 根據教官說明, 綠色三角形代表 Down and Locked; 紅色 UNLK 燈代表 In transit; 完全不亮燈則代表 Up and Locked。這是一套獨立於主要指示器的備用指示系統。

mc_questions.zh_question: 在電氣系統面板上，BTC (Bus Tie Contactor) 的主要功能是什麼？
zh_options: (A) 當兩具發電機都失效時，自動切斷所有非必要匯流排
(B) 負責將 DC 直流電轉換為 AC 交流固定頻率電
(C) 允許單一電源 (發電機或外部電源) 供電給整個系統的匯流排
(D) 控制電池充電器的充電速率
mc_questions.en_question: On the Main Elec Power panel, what is the primary function of the BTC (Bus Tie Contactor)?
en_options: (A) Automatically shed non-essential buses when both generators fail
(B) Convert DC power to AC constant frequency power
(C) Allow a single power source (Gen or Ext Pwr) to power the entire system buses
(D) Control the charging rate of the battery chargers
mc_questions.explanation: BTC (Bus Tie Contactor) 匯流排聯結接觸器可以手動或自動運作，其作用是聯通兩側的匯流排，使單一電力來源能覆蓋全機系統。

mc_questions.zh_question: 在引擎火警面板上，關於偵測環路 (Loops) 的故障指示邏輯，下列何者正確？
zh_options: (A) 只要有一個環路偵測到火警，火警手柄就會亮起紅燈
(B) 必須兩個環路 (Loop A & B) 同時偵測到火警，火警手柄才會亮起紅燈
(C) 如果只有一個環路偵測到異常，會觸發 FAULT 燈而非火警警告
(D) FAULT 燈亮起代表滅火瓶已經壓力不足
mc_questions.en_question: On the Engine Fire panel, which of the following is correct regarding the detection loop logic?
en_options: (A) Fire handle illuminates red if only one loop detects fire
(B) Both Loop A and B must detect fire simultaneously for the handle to turn red
(C) If only one loop detects a condition, a FAULT light is triggered instead of a fire warning
(D) FAULT light means the fire extinguisher bottle has low pressure
mc_questions.explanation: 火警警告需要兩個環路同時偵測到火情。若只有單一環路偵測到異常，系統會判定為環路故障並亮起 FAULT 燈，此時可將故障環路關閉 (OFF)，剩餘環路仍可提供正常的火警偵測邏輯。

cloze_items.cloze_text: The Propeller Brake locks the propeller on {{c1::Engine 2}}, enabling it to drive the DC generator and provide air conditioning on the ground (Hotel Mode).
cloze_items.zh_translation: 螺旋槳煞車會鎖定 2 號引擎的螺旋槳，使其能帶動直流發電機並在地面提供空調（即 Hotel Mode）。
cloze_items.explanation: ATR 著名的 Hotel Mode 僅能在 2 號引擎運作，因為只有該側裝有 Prop Brake。

cloze_items.cloze_text: When the power supply to the DC Standby Bus is less than {{c1::19.5}} volts, an undervoltage light is illuminated.
cloze_items.zh_translation: 當直流備用匯流排 (DC Standby Bus) 的供電電壓低於 19.5 伏特時，欠壓指示燈會亮起。
cloze_items.explanation: 這是監控緊急電源狀態的重要限制數據。

cloze_items.cloze_text: Ice protection level 1 consists of {{c1::Probes Heating}} and windshield heating, which are normally kept on throughout the flight.
cloze_items.zh_translation: 第一級防冰保護包含感應器加熱 (Probes Heating) 與擋風玻璃加熱，通常在整個飛行過程中都保持開啟。
cloze_items.explanation: 這是 ATR 防冰系統邏輯的最基礎層級，與大氣條件無關。

cloze_items.cloze_text: The hydraulic auxiliary pump is driven by {{c1::DC Power}} and acts as a backup for the Blue system.
cloze_items.zh_translation: 液壓輔助泵 (Aux Pump) 是由直流電 (DC Power) 驅動的，作為藍色系統的備援。
cloze_items.explanation: 區別於主泵 (AC Wild 驅動)，輔助泵提供緊急情況下的基本液壓需求。

cloze_items.cloze_text: Pulling the fire handle arms the two fire extinguisher bottles, indicated by a {{c1::SQUIB}} light in the agent pushbuttons.
cloze_items.zh_translation: 拉起火警手柄會備炸兩具滅火瓶，這會由滅火藥劑按鈕中的 SQUIB 燈號顯示。
cloze_items.explanation: SQUIB 燈亮代表滅火系統的導爆管電路已連通，隨時可以釋放藥劑。

cloze_items.cloze_text: The fuel LP (Low Pressure) valve is always open unless the {{c1::Fire Handle}} is pulled.
cloze_items.zh_translation: 燃油低壓 (LP) 閥門平時始終保持開啟，除非火警手柄被拉起。
cloze_items.explanation: 拉起 Fire Handle 會物理切斷進入引擎供油線路的最後一道關卡。
